articles.headline: McDavid posts 10th assist as Oilers beat Sharks 3-1 for 4th straight win
articles.description: — Connor McDavid recorded his 13th point of the season and 10th assist as the Edmonton Oilers beat the San Jose Sharks 3-1 on Saturday for their fourth straight win.

articles.headline: Nico Hischier has 2 goals and an assist to help the Devils roll to a 4-1 win over the Canucks
articles.description: — Nico Hischier scored two goals and added an assist while Jesper Bratt had a goal and an assist in the New Jersey Devils' 4-1 win over the Vancouver Canucks on Saturday.

articles.headline: Fraser Minten has a goal and two assists as Bruins roll past winless Flyers 5-1
articles.description: — Fraser Minten had a goal and two assists, Pavel Zacha scored his first goal of the season and the Boston Bruins beat the struggling Philadelphia Flyers 5-1 on Saturday.
